meta.notes:
**Checked** 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-13, headless Chromium, iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA 1280x800, logged out.

## whatsapp.com and the Web login (LIVE)

- `https://web.whatsapp.com/` on an iPhone UA redirects to `/mobile/`, a static page with nothing hideable. With a desktop UA it shows the QR login: `[data-testid=download-native-client-button]` and `-inline` 1 each.
- `https://www.whatsapp.com/`: header `a[href*=itunes.apple.com]` 2, hero article download 1, footer itunes links 3, `section[data-testid=waui_section]` 11, `footer[data-testid=whatsapp_www_footer]` 1. `/download` keeps its primary iOS button (it is in a section, not an article).
- 2026-11-13 on the saved home page HTML loaded in Chromium: `[data-testid=whatsapp_www_full_page] picture` 18, and each `section:has(a[href="https://www.whatsapp.com/calling"])`, `.../privacy`, `.../community`, `.../messaging` matched exactly 1. The first banner section is not hit by any feature-section rule; the Transform your business and Call on WhatsApp Web sections stay under the existing promo option.
- The classes on www (`_9ta2` style) are hashed and avoided; rules use `data-testid` and `href`. `<video>` matched 0 on the home page, so no video rule exists.

## WhatsApp Web app rules (SOURCE, NOT verified live)

The chat UI needs a phone to log in, so none of this ran. The fixture `web-app.html` is hand-written and the rules follow public community CSS:

- SOURCE `#pane-side [role="row"]` blur: andryompusunggu.com/blog/pure-css-whatsapp-blur and the greasyfork WhatsApp UI Manager (`#pane-side [role="row"] { filter: blur(6px) }`). Those extensions also clear the blur on `:hover`; this recipe cannot, because a recipe selector with a pseudo-class like `:hover` cannot be checked against a fixture, so the blur is permanent while the option is on.
- SOURCE `#main .message-in` and `.message-out` (message bubble classes used by dark-whatsapp and privacy gists). INFERRED that blur on the whole bubble is fine; the older `_3mKlI`-style hashed names are not used.
- SOURCE `[data-testid="group-chat-profile-picture"]` (greasyfork Clean UI). `#pane-side img` and `#main header img` are INFERRED from the same structure.
- SOURCE `[aria-label="Channels"]` (greasyfork Remove Channels script; English UI only) and `[aria-label*="Meta AI"]` (Clean UI context-menu rule). A contact literally named Meta AI could also match.
- Reddit r/uBlockOrigin (Jun 2025) reports WhatsApp changes its menu markup often, so expect drift.

## Left alone on purpose

The compose box, chat text, QR and phone-number login, and the primary Download button on `/download`.
